item.title: USD/CHF softens to near 0.7950 as Trump's tariff threats drive safe-haven demand for Swiss Franc
item.description: The USD/CHF pair trades in the negative territory for the third consecutive day around 0.7960 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The Swiss Franc (CHF) strengthens against the Greenback as US President Donald Trump's tariff threats spark safe-haven demand.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in Saudi Arabia on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Australian Dollar gains as US Dollar dips on US–Greenland tensions
item.description: The Australian Dollar advances against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, extending its gains for the second successive session. The AUD/USD pair appreciates as the Greenback struggles amid escalating uncertainty surrounding the United States (US)–Greenland issue.

item.title: US President Donald Trump: We will be talking about Greenland in Davos
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that he will be talking about Greenland in Davos, Switzerland.

item.title: GBP/JPY ticks up to near 212.40 ahead of UK employment data
item.description: The GBP/JPY pair edges higher to near 212.45 during the Asian trading session on Tuesday. The pair ticks up as the Japanese Yen (JPY) underperforms its peers, following the announcement of a snap election by Japan’s Prime Minister (PM) Sanae Takaichi on Monday.

item.title: USD/INR revisits all-time high on sustained US Dollar’s demand by Indian importers
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its losing streak for the fourth trading day against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen struggles to gain traction amid mixed cues as traders await BoJ decision
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) struggles to capitalize on its modest Asian session gains against a broadly weaker US Dollar (USD) as bulls seem reluctant to place aggressive bets amid domestic political uncertainty.

item.title: WTI declines below $59.50 as Iran tensions ease and US-EU trade war fears grow
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $59.25 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The WTI price edges lower as Iran supply fears ease, while traders closely monitor the fallout from the United States (US) push to take control of Greenland.

item.title: Gold climbs beyond $4,700; fresh record high and counting amid flight to safety
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts buyers for the second straight day and climbs beyond the $4,700 mark, hitting a fresh all-time peak during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Finds temporary support near 20-day EMA
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades 0.13% lower to near 1.3850 during the early European trading session on Tuesday. The Loonie pair is under pressure as the US Dollar (USD) remains on the back foot amid disputes between the United States (US) and the European Union (EU) over the future of Greenland.
